summary.intent: Rename the UAT branch to a fix branch and apply a fix for a major finding: unbound fetch calls in the external pinning providers that fail in browser contexts.
summary.outcome: Branch renamed to fix/..., `this`-binding fix applied to both kubo-provider.ts and psa-provider.ts, regression tests written and verified to fail without the fix and pass with it, all committed.

Pinning provider tests live under packages/sdk-core/src/__tests__/pinning/.
